text: dsh-sidebar-annotate 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的图片批注插件，在右侧栏图片预览头部加入批注入口。打开后可在原图位置叠加画布，使用编号标记、画笔、直线、箭头和形状等工具，并为标记填写说明。发送时插件把原图与笔迹合成为 PNG，将编号说明和图片作为附件提交到当前会话。适合需要在截图或图片上指出细节并交给 DSH 对话处理的用户。需要提供 sidebar.right.tab.document.actions 插槽的 DSH 客户端，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-sidebar-annotate adds an annotation button to images in the DSH web sidebar. Draw markers, notes, lines, arrows, and shapes. Sending combines image and ink into a PNG and attaches it with notes to the current conversation. It needs the sidebar.right.tab.document.actions slot; no API key.
想在图片上圈出问题并把图和说明一起发给 DSH。
怎么给侧边栏里的截图画箭头和编号标记？
I want to mark up an image and send the annotated version with notes into my conversation.
dsh-sidebar-annotate 的功能「图片批注并发送」：在侧边栏图片上绘制标记和笔迹，并可为编号标记填写说明。点击发送后，插件合成 PNG 图片，将图片附件和说明提交到当前会话。

Annotate images in place inside the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: mark, draw, line, arrow, seven shapes, arc and eraser → the composited image plus a numbered note list goes back to the conversation. Zoom in with the wheel to work on details, hold `Space` to pan, and the image is restored when you close the layer.

text:
dsh-sidebar-annotate README · What it does：Open an image in the right sidebar and the preview header gains an **Annotate** button. Click it and the image becomes drawable: the ink layer sits exactly on top of the picture where it already is, with a toolbar capsule under it. Nothing is moved, nothing is dimmed, no centred dialog opens.

When you send, the plugin composites the original image with your ink, numbers every marker, and hands the result to the conversation together with a note list:

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · What it does：```
I marked spots on this image:
1. the button in the top right
2. the spacing here
The numbers in the image match the list above.

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Features：| Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | Annotate in place | The layer measures the previewed `` rectangle and paints a canvas at the same coordinates; zoom, scroll and the official renderer are untouched | | Six tools | Mark (click to drop a numbered marker and write one line), pen, arrow, rectangle, square, triangle | | Corner-first shapes | Press and drag from a corner; the square locks to equal sides and takes the longer edge | | Colour and width | Four presets plus a custom picker; three preset width dots plus a continuous 1–12 px slider, both editing the same value | | Undo and redo | Ordered by when you did things, not by category; a marker added after a stroke is undone before the stroke | | Numbered markers | Blue circle with a white ring and a white number, anchored to normalised coordinates so it survives window resizes | | One-shot send | Original image + ink exported as PNG (downscaled past 4096 px on the longest side), attached through the official draft path and submitted with your note list | | Keyboard first | `V P A R S T` for tools, `[` `]` for width, `Ctrl+Z` undo, `Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` redo, `Esc` to back out; th

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Interaction flow：```
Open an image in the right sidebar
        │
        ▼
Preview header: [Annotate]  ──▶  toolbar capsule appears under the image

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · The panel：A single translucent capsule under the image, left to right: six tool cells — colour swatches with a custom picker — three width dots and a slider — undo, redo, clear — marker count — cancel, send. Key hints render below the capsule on an absolutely positioned line so the capsule never grows into two rows.

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Demo：A real session: rectangle, square, triangle and a pen line drawn on a test image, with the toolbar capsule underneath — six tools, colour presets plus a custom picker, three width dots and the slider, undo / redo / clear, the marker count, cancel and send.

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Install：Not published to npm. Install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh-sidebar-annotate README · recommended — install from this repository：dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add git+https://github.com/HuaLQIn/dsh-sidebar-annotate.git

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · or — clone, then install from a local path (development)：git clone https://github.com/HuaLQIn/dsh-sidebar-annotate.git
cd dsh-sidebar-annotate
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add .
```

`<your-profile>` is the profile you actually run: `web` for the browser build, `desktop` for the desktop app.

**Then fully quit and reopen the host.** The client bundle is composed at boot; reloading the window does not pick up a new plugin build.
section: or — clone, then install from a local path (development)

text: dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Package name：The package is `dsh-sidebar-annotate`. The CLI writes two places for you: the profile `package.json` dependency and the `dsh.profile.bundles` entry. Do not install a second copy under a different name — the two would register the same slot and both toolbars would render.

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Requirements：- Node.js 20 or newer (`engines.node` in `package.json`)
- A DSH build that provides the `sidebar.right.tab.document.actions` slot (introduced with the document-preview package)
- Tested against DeepSeek Harness desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` with a web client build; other versions are untested

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Requirements：`package.json` deliberately declares **no `engines.dsh` and no `@deepseek-ai/*` peer dependencies**. A strict semver range rejects pre-release host versions such as `0.2.1-rc.2`, and the install is skipped without any error message — silence, not a failure you can see.

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Keyboard：| Key | Tool or action |
| --- | --- |
| `V` | Mark |
| `P` | Pen |
| `A` | Arrow |
| `R` | Rectangle |
| `S` | Square (equal sides) |
| `T` | Triangle |
| `[` / `]` | Width preset down / up |
| `Ctrl+Z` | Undo the last action |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` | Redo |
| `Esc` | Close the note card, then the layer |

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Do / Don't：| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Install with `dsh plugin add` and let it write both places | Insert the same id again by hand in `cordis.patch.yml` |
| Fully quit the host and reopen after installing | Assume a window reload picked up the new build |

Self-check after installing:

```bash
dsh --profile <your-profile> --dump-config | rg "id: dsh-sidebar-annotate"   # exactly one line
```

In the browser console of the running host:

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Do / Don't：```js
window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries.find(({ id }) => id === 'dsh-sidebar-annotate')
// should return an entry with a url; if undefined, the plugin did not load
```

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Compatibility notes：- Images only: png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, bmp, ico. PDF, browser tabs, element picking and text annotation are not implemented.
- No eraser, background removal or resize — that is image editing, not annotation, and it belongs to a different toolbar.
- The composite keeps the natural image size. A picture whose longest side exceeds 4096 px is downscaled before export so the sidebar does not allocate hundreds of megabytes.
- Undo removes whole strokes and whole markers. There is no partial erase.
- When the image scrolls out of the viewport the layer hides and keeps its state.
- If the conversation is busy submitting, attachments are refused and the layer reports it instead of queueing silently.
- Very large images may take a moment to export; the send button shows a sending state meanwhile.

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-sidebar-annotate
```

Or delete the dependency line and the `dsh.profile.bundles` entry from the profile `package.json` by hand, then fully quit and reopen the host. No files outside the profile are touched. Annotation state lives in memory only and is discarded when the layer closes, so there is nothing left to clean up in the browser.

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Version history：| Version | Highlights |
| --- | --- |
| 0.6.2 | Shape drag reverted to corner-first after real use; the centre-out variant is kept in the source tree as an alternate build |
| 0.6.1 | Shapes briefly drawn from the pointer position outward as a centre anchor |
| 0.6.0 | Toolbar rebuilt to the caption-capsule look; continuous width slider; custom colour; redo added |
| 0.5.0 | Six tools with keyboard shortcuts; three width presets; undo ordered by action sequence |
| 0.4.x | Main mode became the numbered-marker + note-card flow; pen kept as a secondary mode |
| 0.1.0 – 0.3.0 | In-place annotation layer, pen, arrow and box; earlier versions used a centred dialog |

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · Design reference：The annotation feature inside the Codex desktop app (internal codename *popcorn*) was read from its own `app.asar` and used as the visual reference: accent `#339CFF`, 2 px dashed selection outline with 10 % fill, marker with `border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 3px`, a custom SVG cursor with hotspot 13,12, and the caption capsule (`rounded-full`, translucent, backdrop blur, 1 px ring). No code was copied — only the visual language.

text:
dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 它做什么：在右侧边栏打开一张图片，预览头部会多出一个**批注**按钮。点开之后图片就变成可画的：墨迹层精确覆盖在图片本来的位置上，下面浮着一条工具栏胶囊。图不移动、不加遮罩、不弹居中对话框。

发送时，插件把原图和笔迹合成一张图，给每个标记编号，连同说明列表一起交给对话：

```
我在这张图上标了几处：
1. 右上角那个按钮
2. 这里的间距
图上的数字和上面编号一一对应。

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 功能：| 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 原地批注 | 量出预览 `` 的屏幕矩形，在同坐标铺一层画布；缩放、滚动与官方渲染器都不动 | | 七格工具 | 标记（点一下落编号并写一句）、画笔、直线、箭头、形状（矩形/正方形/三角形/椭圆/菱形/星形/心形）、圆弧、橡皮 | | 缩放平移 | 滚轮 1×–6×（指针为锚点）、空格拖平移、`0` 复位；关层自动还原 | | 橡皮 | 拖过哪里擦哪里，直径＝粗细 ×4，只擦笔迹不伤底图 | | 从角起画 | 按住拖动，从按下那个角开始；正方形锁等边，取长边 | | 颜色与粗细 | 四个预设 + 自定义取色；三个预设粗细点 + 一条 1–12px 连续滑轨，两种控件改的是同一个值 | | 撤销与重做 | 按动手先后撤，不按类别；先画一笔再标一处，先撤的是标记 | | 编号标记 | 蓝底白环白字的圆点，按归一化坐标锚定，改窗口大小不跑偏 | | 一次发出 | 原图 + 笔迹导出 PNG（最长边超过 4096px 时等比缩），走官方草稿链路挂附件并带着说明列表提交 | | 键盘优先 | `V P A R S T` 切工具，`[` `]` 调粗细，`Ctrl+Z` 撤销，`Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` 重做，`Esc` 逐层退出；键位提示挂在胶囊下方 | | 输入法安全 | 焦点在说明卡里时不抢键，打字不会被吞 | | 自动收工 | 连续三次（约 1.2 秒）找不到图片就自己关闭；同一 tab 换文件会清掉旧墨迹 |

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 交互流程：```
在右侧边栏打开一张图片
        │
        ▼
预览头部出现 [批注]  ──▶  图片下方浮出工具栏胶囊
dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 工具栏：图片下方一条半透明胶囊，从左到右依次是：七格工具 — 色板与自定义取色 — 三个粗细点与滑轨 — 撤销、重做、清空 — 标记数量 — 取消、发送。键位提示用绝对定位挂在胶囊下方单独一行，所以胶囊始终是单行，不会被撑成两排。
dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 演示：真实会话里截的：在测试图上画了长方形、正方形、三角形和一条画笔线，下面就是工具栏胶囊 —— 七格工具、四个预设色加自定义取色、三个粗细点与滑轨、撤销 / 重做 / 清空、标记数量、取消与发送。

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 安装：没有发布到 npm，从本仓库直装：

```bash
dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 推荐：直接从仓库装：dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add git+https://github.com/HuaLQIn/dsh-sidebar-annotate.git

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 或者：先克隆，再从本地路径装（开发调试用）：git clone https://github.com/HuaLQIn/dsh-sidebar-annotate.git
cd dsh-sidebar-annotate
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add .
```

`<你的 profile>` 填你实际在跑的那个：浏览器版是 `web`，桌面版是 `desktop`。

**装完要完全退出宿主再重开。** 客户端脚本只在启动时组合，重载窗口不会换上新版本。

text:
dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 包名与安装冲突：包名是 `dsh-sidebar-annotate`。CLI 会替你把两处都写好：profile 的 `package.json` 依赖，以及 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的条目。

不要用别的名字再装一份：两份会注册同一个插槽，工具栏会重叠渲染。

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 环境要求：- Node.js 20 或更新（`package.json` 里的 `engines.node`）
- 提供 `sidebar.right.tab.document.actions` 插槽的 DSH 版本（随文档预览包引入）
- 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的 Web 客户端上验过；其他版本未测

`package.json` **故意不写 `engines.dsh`，也不写 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peerDependencies**。严格 semver 会把 `0.2.1-rc.2` 这类预发布版判为不满足，安装会被静默跳过 —— 没有报错，只有「装了却没用」。

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 键位：| 键 | 工具或动作 |
| --- | --- |
| `V` | 标记 |
| `P` | 画笔 |
| `A` | 箭头 |
| `R` | 长方形 |
| `S` | 正方形（等边） |
| `T` | 三角形 |
| `[` / `]` | 粗细预设降 / 升一档 |
| `Ctrl+Z` | 撤销最后一次操作 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` | 重做 |
| `Esc` | 先关说明卡，再关整层 |

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 该做与该避免：| 该做 | 避免 |
| --- | --- |
| 用 `dsh plugin add` 装，让它自己写两处 | 手工再往 `cordis.patch.yml` 里插一遍同名 id |
| 装完完全退出宿主再重开 | 以为刷新窗口就换上了新版本 |

装完自检：

```bash
dsh --profile <你的 profile> --dump-config | rg "id: dsh-sidebar-annotate"   # 必须正好一行
```

在运行中的宿主浏览器控制台里：

```js
window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries.find(({ id }) => id === 'dsh-sidebar-annotate')
// 有 url 才算加载成功；返回 undefined 说明插件没起来
```

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 兼容与限制：- 只做图片：png、jpg、jpeg、webp、gif、bmp、ico。PDF、网页标签页、元素指认、文字标注都没做。
- 不做去背景、改尺寸、滤镜。那属于图片编辑，不是批注，在别的工具条里。
- 合成图保持原图自然尺寸；最长边超过 4096px 时先等比缩，避免一次分配几百兆内存。
- 撤销是整笔、整点地撤，没有局部擦除。
- 图片滚出可视区时整层隐藏并保留状态，滚回来继续。
- 会话正在提交时附件会被拒，浮层会报出来，不会静默排队。
- 超大图导出需要一点时间，那期间发送按钮显示发送中。

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-sidebar-annotate
```

或者手工删掉 profile `package.json` 里的依赖行和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里同名一行，然后完全退出宿主再重开。profile 之外不改任何文件。批注状态只存在内存里，层关闭即丢弃，浏览器里没有残留要清。

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 版本历史：| 版本 | 要点 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.6.2 | 形状拖动按实际使用反馈改回「从角起画」；中心锚定版留在源码树里作为备选 |
| 0.6.1 | 形状短暂改成「以按下点为中心往外长」 |
| 0.6.0 | 工具栏改成胶囊毛玻璃外观；加连续粗细滑轨、自定义取色、重做 |
| 0.5.0 | 六种工具 + 键盘快捷键；三档粗细；撤销按操作顺序 |
| 0.4.x | 主模式改为「编号标记 + 说明卡」；画笔降为副模式 |
| 0.1.0 – 0.3.0 | 原地批注层、画笔、箭头、方框；更早版本用过居中对话框 |

dsh-sidebar-annotate README · 设计出处：Codex 桌面版的批注功能（内部代号 popcorn）从它自己的 `app.asar` 里读出，作为视觉参照：强调色 `#339CFF`、2px 蓝色虚线选框加 10% 淡填、`border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 3px` 的编号标记、热点 13,12 的自定义 SVG 光标，以及胶囊容器（`rounded-full`、半透明、背景模糊、1px 细环）。没有拷贝任何代码，只借了视觉语言。

- 私下报告安全问题：[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
- 社区行为约定：[CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
